seo.title: AI Image Generator | Alfora
seo.description: Generate AI images directly in your browser with Alfora Image Generator 2.1. Local WebGPU processing, automatic styles, references and filters.
seo.ogDescription: Generate AI images in your browser using WebGPU, automatic styles, references and filters.
seo.twitterDescription: Generate AI images directly on your device with Alfora.

status.localProcessing: No API · processed on your device

engine.modelSizeInfo: The complete model is around 2.4 GB. The browser may reuse its HTTP cache when possible, but Alfora no longer requires reserving 2.4 GB of site storage in order to work.
engine.readyCopy: The interface is ready. AI libraries will load only when you press Load engine.
engine.memoryReleasedCopy: The generator RAM/GPU memory was released. Press “Load engine” to prepare ONNX Runtime again.
engine.preparingCopy: Preparing the generator without requiring installation in site storage.
engine.readyLoadedCopy: Engine ready. The model loaded directly into WebGPU without depending on OPFS/Cache Storage.

personalize.stylePromptPlaceholder: The style complement will appear here.

composer.imageModeNeedsReference: Image → image needs a reference. Press “Use” on a loaded image.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.description: Technical parameters, diagnostics and engine behavior.
advanced.noPromptYet: There is no request to combine yet.
advanced.translationCopy: this box must show in English the prompt SD-Turbo will receive. Alfora will not send partial mixed-language translations.
advanced.cfgDescription: It compares a prediction conditioned by your prompt with another one without a prompt. In this version, tested styles use CFG 1.5. Values other than 1 require a second UNet execution per step and may take longer.
advanced.storageCopy: Generation no longer depends on reserving the complete model in the browser's private storage.
advanced.stableModelCopy: ONNX Runtime loads components directly from their URL, one by one. This reduces storage pressure and keeps the engine running locally with WebGPU.

filters.defaultDescription: These values are automatically applied to future images after the VAE. Test them here to find Alfora's optimal visual configuration. They do not change images that were already generated.
filters.applyDefaultSuffix: these values will be used as default filters for the next generations in the session.
filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Adjust only the selected generation. Changes are previewed here and saved to that image when you press Apply filters.
filters.note: Alfora applies a gentle contrast, color and definition adjustment to every new generation. You can change it here without affecting other images.

external.title: Ask an external AI for help and save credits on your paid AIs.
external.description: Create an automatic request with the format you need and ask your preferred AI to refine the prompt for a more precise request.
external.whatDraw: What do you want to draw?
external.subjectPlaceholder: Example: premium ice cream on ice
external.expectationsPlaceholder: Composition, mood, important elements, feeling, etc.
external.logoReference: Add your logo or images with reference colors
external.colorAnalysisCopy: Alfora will analyze the main colors locally and fill the color selectors. You can edit them afterward.
external.copiedDescription: A request was copied to your clipboard so you can consult your preferred AI.

activation.title: Connect the browser engine before generating.
activation.description: For Alfora's image AI to work, you need to connect the browser engine. Alfora processes locally with WebGPU and uses your device GPU. Before starting, review the usage and implications of this connection.
activation.whatToKnow: What you should know before connecting it
activation.firstLoadCopy: The first activation can take a moment while the browser checks compatibility, downloads components and prepares the model. After that, generation runs from your device.
activation.gpuImpact: It will use your device GPU and may increase energy use, memory use and temperature.
activation.performanceImpact: Other heavy tabs or apps may run more slowly while you generate.
activation.batteryImpact: On laptops or mobile devices, battery may drain faster while it is in use.
activation.lowPowerTip: On modest devices, closing heavy processes before generating may help.
activation.recommendationCopy: If possible, use a stable connection for the model's first load, keep your laptop connected to power and avoid running many graphics-heavy apps at the same time.

viewer.inspectCopy: You can inspect the image while the system keeps working.
viewer.clickToExpand: Click to view the image larger
